projectDescription.text: We are the City of Greenville, and our project involves building a connected network of protected bike lanes and widened sidewalks linking downtown, the hospital district, and two low-income neighborhoods that currently lack a safe walking or biking route. The project spans about 6 miles in an urban area. Our total estimated project cost is $18 million, and we plan to request $12 million in federal funds. We have completed a bike and pedestrian master plan for the corridor and are now starting 30 percent design on the project.
